subject: FluxAI cost check + model-mix confirmation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Adele Thompson <adele@fluxai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap and two asks — token mix + target $/1M

Hi Adele — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and two asks so we can turn your pilot into a clean purchase path: 

Recap from call:
- Primary workload: customer support assistant for web + in-app messaging (first 6 months: triage + suggested replies; months 6–12: generative responses with retrieval).
- Expected steady-state traffic (month 6): ~150M tokens/month. Peak day ratio ~1.8x.
- Retrieval/semantic search for KB: embeddings used for 2M queries/month.
- Reranking on search results ~300k requests/month.

Model-mix we sketched (please confirm):
- Chat (streaming generation): ~62% of token volume (~93M tokens/month)
- Embeddings (indexing + query vectors): ~28% of token-equivalent volume (~42M tokens/month equivalent)
- Rerank (short prompt + candidate scoring): ~10% (~15M tokens/month)

Two asks to finalize a pricing illustration: 
1) Confirm monthly token target range (pick low/expected/high). Our draft: 80M / 150M / 260M tokens.
2) Confirm target unit economics you need: you mentioned target ~$65 / 1M tokens as an internal threshold — can you confirm if that’s per all-token-equivalent or only for chat tokens?

If you confirm the two items above, I’ll send a 3-band cost sheet (low/expected/high) with per-model breakout and options for 10% reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go. I’ve attached the CSV sample you promised to share so we can map real traffic shape (fluxai_usage_sample.csv).

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Adele Thompson <adele@fluxai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@fluxai.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap and two asks — token mix + target $/1M

Thanks Priyom — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming the traffic bands: low 95M / expected 150M / high 275M tokens (the users we onboard in Q1 raise per-user token use).
- The $65 / 1M token is our cross-product target for total token spend (we budget at account level). We realize embeddings have a different cost profile; feel free to show embedded pricing separate but total blended should be in that ballpark for procurement to greenlight.
- For embeddings: we expect ~2.5M query vectors/month and ~1.2M index updates (batches) in month.
- Rerank calls are shorter; assume 350k calls/month with ~250 tokens per call.

Timeline: procurement wants a simple SOW + two price bands (commit vs PAYG). Ideally we have something before 9/24 so we can include in the Oct cycle.

—Adele
Adele Thompson | Head of Product | FluxAI
adele@fluxai.com | +1 415-555-9901
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Adele Thompson <adele@fluxai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap and two asks — token mix + target $/1M

Adele — thanks, that helps a lot. Attached a concise three-band pricing illustration (Proposed_SOW_v1.pdf) and a quick per-model unit-econ table below. I’ll summarize options and ask a single follow-up to get procurement details.

Blended cost assumptions (illustrative):
- PAYG baseline rates we used for calc (examples): chat model family: $0.085 / 1k tokens (generation + inputs counted), embeddings: $0.50 / 1k vectors for indexing + $0.10 / 1k vectors for queries (converted to token-equivalent for blended view), rerank: $0.045 / 1k tokens equivalent.

Example blended outcomes (for expected 150M tokens + embeddings / rerank volumes you provided):
- PAYG blended estimate: ~$78 / 1M tokens (includes embeddings & rerank converted to token-eq)
- 10% reserved capacity discount band: ~$70 / 1M
- 30% reserved capacity / 12‑month commit band: ~$59 / 1M

Per-model split we used to build the sheet (please confirm):
- Chat: 62% tokens -> 93M tokens/month
- Embeddings: 28% token-eq -> 42M tokens/month + separate vector-rate lines in sheet
- Rerank: 10% -> 15M tokens/month (short prompts)

Questions / next steps: 
1) Is the 30% commit (12mo) acceptable to get to ~$59 / 1M? If not, what commit level would procurement consider?
2) Please confirm billing entity and PO flow (procurement email for PO is helpful).
3) Any required compliance docs we should include up front (SOC2, DPA) — we can bundle into the SOW.

I’ve looped Vanessa to confirm discounting approvals and Karthik to validate the model-family mappings (we may be able to shift chat->smaller chat variants for 8–12% additional saving with minimal quality delta).

If that looks directionally right I’ll prep a 1-page SOW + two price tables (commit vs PAYG) and send to procurement.

Thanks — Priyom
